question: Can the sealed Gate-1 range/teacher dataset satisfy independent replay, deterministic replacement and scientific visualization evidence without changing or re-exporting the dataset?
method: Verify both source seals; reconstruct the frozen selector and every attempted candidate; cast each attempted frame through two newly constructed Open3D scenes; compare selected scans and objective teachers with sealed Zarr/manifest; persist every replay metric and rejected candidate reason; generate train-only complete sample, spatial coverage and aggregate distribution figures.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only Open3D replay in the frozen E1+Zarr environment; no Gazebo, Isaac, GPU or training.

approval.scope: One corrective evidence-only Gate-1 execution over the sealed 80/10, 22500-cluster, 112500-frame dataset; no mutation, re-export or training.
